Despite the lack of clear correlation between carbon intensity and model performance, there are some interesting observations to be made based on Figure 4. While we did not expect to see a strong link between these two factors, we find it worth noting that neither consuming more energy nor emitting more carbon seems to necessarily correlate with a higher accuracy, even in tasks such as Machine Translation, where Transformer models are largely seen to do better compared to other models  $^{5}$
